cards.title: Evidence and uncertainty
items: VERIFIED = inspected source at ded15187b5fe; source references are static evidence, not runtime traces.
INFERRED = configuration-based deployment assumption; explicitly prefixed on its arrow.
No origin remote exists. Source paths and pinned excerpts are available in source.html; no remote identity is invented.

cards.title: Tooling and development flows
items: scripts/check_alignment_inprocess.py:main() copies public inputs to a temp root, sets STUDENT_ROOT and invokes check() through asyncio.run().
scripts/check_alignment_ui.js loads renderer source into node:vm with stub api/DOM; tests/conftest.py creates a temporary app root and TestClient fixtures.
scripts/browser_qa.py uses Playwright callbacks against a live deployment and real admin credentials; analyzed only, not executed.

cards.title: Historical automation entry
items: scripts/start_report_alignment.sh creates a snapshot/worktree/tmux session, then --worker invokes codex using prompts/report-alignment.md.
The shell worker subsequently runs pytest and commits if its ready marker passes; this workflow was inspected, not launched.
Python → SQLite/sklearn/NumPy and browser automation libraries use external native runtimes; their implementation is outside this repository.
